capabilities: Copy a formatted note citation with file link and line numbers to the clipboard
Choose a citation mode from a filterable picker in editor or reading mode
Define custom ref modes with named citation templates
Insert template placeholders for filename, line ranges, and newlines
Configure how file paths resolve (file name, vault-relative, or absolute)
extras: The README is instructions-only; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian gives AI agents no easy way to receive precise references to a specific note and its line ranges when users describe their vault in chat.
summary: Clipboard tool that copies a note citation with file link, line numbers, and a custom prompt template for pasting into AI agent chats.
